def div_even_odd(list1):
    """Write a function to find the division of first even and odd number of a given list."""
    first_even = next((num for num in list1 if num % 2 == 0), None)
    first_odd = next((num for num in list1 if num % 2 != 0), None)
    if first_even is None or first_odd is None:
        raise ValueError("list1 must contain at least one even and one odd number")
    return first_even / first_odd
